implementation.liveContact: After enter closes at age56, cycle samples run ages57..66; exit samples67..76 for one-cycle normal play. Closing samples precede afterContact/Sequence. Each extra quantized cycle adds10 ticks.
implementation.skippedTicks: A gap in attackAge advances at most to the current phase end. No cross-phase catchup; the next phase starts at the observed current age after contact. The attack cannot teleport through multiple unobserved loops.
implementation.lifecycle: begin and cancel reset per-actor state; afterContact evaluates onEnd; snapshot phase/start drives server receiving skin, attacking spheres and client pose. Live completion bypasses legacy96 ticks; root schedules recharge from actual completion.
implementation.sourceContactOnlyHelper: Chest_L_End is unweighted and was previously trimmed. Its original local TRS and reciprocal-parent-scale helper are now retained; no cube, wrist curve, scale or support lift is changed.
implementation.contact: Current articulated pose sphere contacts against actual target surfaces. Source useShapecast is false; no unproven continuous arm capsule or whole-body contact.
